title: Cientista de Dados II
description:
Location: BAL - SEDE

City: São Paulo, Brasil

State: São Paulo (BR-SP)

Country: Brasil (BR)

Requisition Number: 40428

Bunge has an exciting opportunity available for a Data Scientist. In this role, you will be part of a global team working on challenging, meaningful projects impacting core business activities. Since 1818, Bunge has been connecting farmers to consumers to deliver essential food, feed, and fuel to the world. Looking to the future, our ambition is to continuously reinvent ourselves, leveraging data to be at the forefront of analytics, technology, and talent to accomplish our purpose in a better, faster, and simpler way. Bunge is committed to operating and thriving in the digital world – creating world-class agile teams where teammates are empowered and encouraged to collaborate, test, and learn to succeed.

At Bunge, people do not just come here to work; they come here to grow – solving challenges that directly impact the world with a diverse team of thinkers and doers. Bunge offers a strong compensation and benefits package, generous paid time off, flexible work arrangements, and opportunities for career progression. Our hybrid work environment provides a balance of in-office and remote work.

Most importantly, in all we do, we live our values:

  • Act as One Team by fostering inclusion, collaboration, and respect
  • Drive for Excellence by being agile, innovative, and efficient
  • Do What's Right by acting safely, ethically, and sustainably

Overview

We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Senior Data Scientist with strong expertise in predictive and prescriptive modeling applied to industrial operations. As a Senior Data Scientist, you will be responsible for constructing models to solve business problems, communicating with technical teams, and ensuring delivery aligns with business expectations. You will also work with cross-functional teams to identify and prioritize data analytics initiatives.

Main Accountabilities

  • Design, create, test, and implement complex models and algorithms that drive analytical solutions across the organization.
  • Provide technical support for data scientists across multiple squads.
  • Collaborate with business analysts to understand problems and implement scalable solutions.
  • Define development standards and solution approaches.
  • Design and structure reusable codebases.
  • Coordinate with MIS, Digital Specialists, and Data Engineers to deliver comprehensive analytical solutions.
  • Communicate the design, functioning, and output of analytical models/solutions.
  • Ensure timely analysis and testing for maintenance of solutions.
  • Present data insights to stakeholders.

Knowledge and Technical Competencies

  • Make decisions aligned with Bunge’s strategy, business needs, and financial goals, exploring new perspectives through innovation.
  • Build strong relationships, influence others, and develop talent.
  • Develop data-driven strategies aligned with company priorities and communicate effectively.
  • Proficient in data science, machine learning, programming languages like Python or R, SQL, data analysis, teamwork, and communication skills.
  • Assist in structuring problems/hypotheses and translating them into advanced analytics approaches, including machine learning and optimization.
  • Help business understand data science and optimization concepts for better cross-functional communication.

Education/Experience

  • Advanced knowledge in mathematics, analytics, and computer science, including machine learning, statistical models, and data science programming.
  • Avoid logical flaws, build resilient data pipelines in cloud environments, and prepare high-quality data.
  • Mentor associates and data scientists, and communicate effectively with stakeholders and management.
  • Model behavior as a team player and foster new ideas.

Bunge (NYSE: BG) is a global leader in sourcing, processing, and supplying oilseed and grain products and ingredients. Founded in 1818, Bunge’s network supports over 70,000 farmers and consumers worldwide, with headquarters in St. Louis, Missouri, and 25,000 employees globally, operating numerous facilities and terminals.

Bunge is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, national origin, citizenship, age, disability, or veteran status. Minorities, women, veterans, and disabled persons are encouraged to apply.

QUEM SOMOS?
Prazer, somos a Suzano!
Aqui a gente acredita que inovação e sustentabilidade caminham juntas. Dessa união, nasce uma atitude plena de significado: a inovabilidade. Pautados por ela, pensamos fora da caixa e enxergamos longe para lidar com os desafios do século 21. Nós plantamos e cultivamos árvores para transformar essa matéria-prima renovável em Bioprodutos para o dia a dia de mais de 2 bilhões de pessoas. Cultivamos a vida na folha do caderno que alfabetiza as crianças, na fralda que protege os bebês, no copo de café que não prejudica o meio ambiente, em papéis absorventes e na comodidade do uso de uma embalagem sustentável.
PLURAL
Iguais e diferentes. Singulares e plurais.   • Atualização Estratégica: Revisar e atualizar mensalmente o plano estratégico anual, alinhando-o com os objetivos da empresa e com as demandas operacionais, garantindo que as metas sejam atingidas com eficiência.
  • Monitoramento de Desempenho: Acompanhar o desempenho, comparando o previsto com o realizado, analisando os desvios e implementando ações corretivas para garantir alta assertividade na execução, sempre em alinhamento com a operação.
  • Indicadores de Gestão: Criar, monitorar e analisar indicadores de desempenho das operações florestais, fornecendo informações e insights valiosos para apoiar a tomada de decisões estratégicas.

  • Orçamento Anual: Apoiar na elaboração do orçamento anual da área, contribuindo para uma alocação eficiente dos recursos financeiros e garantindo que as operações sejam sustentáveis dentro do planejamento orçamentário.

  • Que proponha ideias e soluções;

  • Formação superior em Engenharia Florestal, Engenharia de Produção ou áreas correlatas;

Ball is thrilled to receive Newsweek's 2023 Top 100 Global Most Loved Workplace award! As a sustainable product leader, we have over 16,000 global team members. From endlessly recyclable aluminum cans, and cups, to aerosol bottles, our goal is to contribute to a better community, society, and world.

Primary Purpose of this Position:
The role forms part of two local manufacturing plants senior management teams and will contribute by delivering highly effective business partnership to our Operations team. In doing so this role will drive financial value in our operating costs being our future fuel for growth. All of the referenced responsibilities below relate to two manufacturing plants that this role will be responsible for supporting.
What will you be responsible for?
• Acts as a trusted business partner to the manufacturing plant leadership teams to support decision making and driving financial value in the form of EVA performance improvement
• In support of the above - monitor and tracks monthly, quarterly and YTD financial related KPI performance and conduct monthly business performance reviews with manufacturing plant management teams
• Analyse the month end financial close results and communicate results to the manufacturing plant operations teams (via standardized Ball Operational Excellence routines) and to the regional finance teams effectively, accurately and timely in standardized formats.
• Leads the local development cross functionally of the manufacturing plant spending forecasts for annual operating plan cycle (AOP) efficiently, accurately and timely in standardized formats
• Leads the local refresh cross functionally of the manufacturing plant spending forecasts for the quarterly refresh of the annual operating plan cycle (3+9, 6+6 & 9+3) efficiently, accurately and timely in standardized formats
• Leads the development of an “in month” monthly refresh of financial forecasts for the manufacturing plant (often referred to as the POV) efficiently, accurately and timely in standardized formats. This serves to drive action and understanding within the manufacturing plant senior management team, but also inform regional financial leadership of financial expectations in the near term.
• Management of local capital budgets, project control and reporting, including all local investment proposals (AFE’s)– cradle to grave oversight from AFE creation to timely asset capitalization and project closure.
• Support finance led regional, manufacturing plant based or otherwise initiatives to drive EVA performance improvement and standardization of processes.
• Support non finance teams education at the manufacturing plant to build strong finance and business acumen around the key principles of how the business run, how we make money and how they can impact EVA each and every day.
NOTE: This role is NOT responsible for the accounting close of the financial books or associated journals / transactions. It is also NOT responsible for participating and coordinating physical inventories and reconciliation at manufacturing plant and associated local warehouses (finished goods, spare parts, materials or assets). These are both supported by the appropriate local functional teams locally and a separate accounting / global business services (GBS) function
What are we looking for?
• Completed Bachelor Degree
• Proven work-related experience
• Strong negotiation and influencing skills
• Systems literate including strong Excel capability
• Ability to organize, plan, and prioritize
• Ability to apply intensive and diversified evaluation, selection, and substantial adaptation and modification of standard finance techniques, procedures, and criteria
• Working knowledge of finance and forecasting principles, general business principles, legal and accounting practices, Economic Value Added (EVA), manufacturing standard costing, financial modelling and generally accepted managerial practices and procedures
• Specific systems experienced preferred within Microsoft suite of applications, ERP systems (SAP, JDE, etc) and Hyperion Essbase (or equivalents)
• Working Manufacturing experience preferred
• English - desirable

Ball Corporation is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We actively encourage applications from everybody, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, faith, ability, or orientation.

When you join Ball you belong to a team of over 16,000 members worldwide. Our products range from infinitely recyclable aluminum cans, cups to aerosol bottles that enable our customers to contribute to a better world.

Each of us has a deep commitment to diversity and inclusion which is the foundation of our culture of belonging. Everyone at Ball is making a difference by doing what we love. Because what we create may change, but what we will always make is a difference.

Please note the advertised job title might vary from the job title on the contract due to local job title structure and global HR systems.

Job Grade: Global Grade 10

title: Senior Industrial Automation Implementation
description:
Customer at TRACTIAN

The Customer team is the driving factor behind lifetime value, retention and expasion at Tractian. We focus on expanding inside existing customers, crosselling to different products, and building even stronger relationships with our current accounts. Our Enterprise customers are comprised of Fortune 500 companies, such as Hyundai, Bosch, Unilever, Suzano, PepsiCo, and others. Every member of our team directly affects the results of our clients. As part of this team, you will be in contact with clients to understand their needs and help create solutions to improve their maintenance processes.

What you'll do

As a Senior Automation Engineer, you will be responsible for reviewing and optimizing technical proposals to ensure alignment with the company’s capabilities and technical requirements, supporting the proper field installation and system integration. You will manage the implementation process, including the integration of sensors, PLCs, and frequency inverters, ensuring that the solutions are robust, scalable, and meet client demands. Additionally, you will oversee the go-live phase, validate system functionality, and provide post-implementation technical support.


Responsibilities
  • Review and adjust technical proposals developed by the Sales team, ensuring they align with the company's capabilities and the required technical specifications, thereby supporting the technical implementation and correct field installation;
  • Verify the compatibility of system integrations (sensors, PLCs, Frequency Inverters, etc.) within the client’s environment, ensuring that the solutions are robust and scalable;
  • Participate in client meetings to better understand their demands and translate these needs into viable technical solutions;
  • Manage the implementation schedule, ensuring that the stages are completed within the established deadlines and that the system functions properly;
  • Supervise the application and go-live phase of the implemented systems, validating the correct functioning of sensors, PLCs, and monitoring systems;
  • Work closely with the Data Science, Hardware, and Platform teams to develop, optimize, and implement features that add value to the solutions;
  • Provide post-implementation technical support, helping to resolve technical issues or make adjustments when necessary;
  • Collaborate with other teams in the company, such as Technical Support and Product Engineering, to ensure that the developed solutions are aligned with the company's capabilities and innovations;
  • Help identify opportunities for upsell or additional improvements in projects, based on technical understanding and customer feedback.
Requirements
  • +5 Years of Industrial Experience, preferably with a background in Industrial Automation and Project Management;
  • Familiarity with handling and programming (Ladder Logic) various PLC brands (Siemens, Allen-Bradley/Rockwell, Schneider Electric, Mitsubishi, etc.);
  • Experience with SCADA, DCS, or other supervisory and control systems;
  • Knowledge of industrial communication protocols such as Modbus, EtherNet/IP, Profibus, or OPC UA for sensor and controller integration;
  • Experience with instrumentation and sensor sizing (level, pressure, flow, humidity, etc.);
  • Ability to work with measurement and control systems for electrical and mechanical variables;
  • Willingness to travel to client plants and ability to conduct technical demonstration meetings;
  • Managing technical projects (scope, implementation schedule, technical sizing, and structural review) alongside the Sales team;
  • Strong communication and negotiation skills, with exceptional ability to present solutions to complex problems.
Bonus Points
  • CMVP Certification;
  • PMP Certification;
  • Experience in asset monitoring;
  • Fluency in English and Spanish.

SOBRE A WHIRLPOOL CORPORATION
Whirlpool Corporation (NYSE: WHR) é uma empresa líder em eletrodomésticos para cozinha e lavanderia, em constante busca por melhorar a vida em casa e inspirar gerações com nossas marcas. A empresa está impulsionando inovações significativas para atender às crescentes necessidades dos consumidores, por meio do portfólio de marcas icônicas, incluindo Whirlpool, KitchenAid, JennAir, Maytag, Amana, Brastemp, Consul e InSinkErator. Em 2023, a empresa registrou aproximadamente US$ 19 bilhões em vendas anuais, 59.000 colaboradores e 55 centros de pesquisa de tecnologia e fabricação. Informações adicionais sobre a empresa podem ser encontradas em WhirlpoolCorp.com.
A equipe da qual você fará parte
A equipe de Segurança e prevenção de perdas protege os funcionários da organização, propriedades e todos os itens de valor nas instalações de qualquer dano ou perigo evitável. Desenvolve políticas e procedimentos de segurança em conformidade com as diretrizes e padrões do governo. Conduz investigações para proteger os ativos da organização.
Resumo desta função
Dentre os principais papeis e desafios dessa posição temos a gestão do time de segurança local, o gerenciamento de projetos de segurança patrimonial, de logística, de imagem e da informação, visando as melhores práticas de proteção de ativos no mercado. Responsável também por sistemas de controle de segurança e desenvolvimento de procedimentos de segurança e prevenção. Além disso, será ponto focal em comitês de crise.
Suas responsabilidades incluirão
Segurança de Pessoas

  • Implantar procedimentos e práticas de controle de acesso de pessoal por meio de sistema eletrônico e procedimentos de forma a garantir a proteção do pessoal na triagem pré-contratação e checagem de antecedentes, quando requerido e necessário; treinamento e educação para conscientização dos funcionários; assessoria em viagens de negócios e intervenção em violência no local de trabalho;
  • Realizar a proteção executiva em caso de visita em nossas fábricas ou escritórios, seguindo as práticas e procedimentos locais alinhados ao Gerente Sênior de Segurança Regional;
Segurança física
  • Realização de avaliação de riscos locais em fábricas, oficiais e armazéns (próprios ou 3PL) proporcionando a atualização na matriz de riscos garantindo a aplicação adequada dos recursos e nas mudanças de estratégia;
  • Assegurar a padronização dos serviços de vigilantes, bem como a gestão dos provedores de segurança;
  • Controle dos serviços de segurança e gestão do orçamento local;
  • Conduzir os projetos novos ou atuais sobre monitoramento de alarmes, segurança e sistemas críticos sempre que necessário e garantir o correto funcionamento.
Prevenção de perdas
  • Conduzir a investigação interna reportando ao Gerente Sênior de Segurança Regional e dar suporte sempre que solicitado;
  • Assegurar o reporte da linha de comunicação entre os colaboradores da Whirlpool e a área de segurança para casos de reclamação ou outros.
  • Manter a rede com as autoridades de segurança locais.
Plano de Continuidade de Negócios / Gerenciamento de Crise
  • Desenvolver o Plano de Continuidade de Negócios e garantir sua atualização constante;
  • Gerenciar os treinamentos periódicos dos representantes das áreas envolvidas;
  • Identificar e fornecer os recursos necessários para colocar no plano.
Gerenciamento de equipe
  • Conduzir a avaliação dos membros da equipe, EPE, etc

title: [Ambev Global Tech] Data Scientist
description:
Job Description

Buscamos um Cientista de Dados para desenvolver soluções analíticas que impulsionem a tomada de decisão estratégica. Você será responsável por conceituar e implementar modelos estatísticos, construir produtos de IA ponta a ponta no Azure DevOps e apresentar insights para a liderança sênior. Esperamos um profissional com experiência em ETL, análise exploratória de dados e modelagem preditiva, além de conhecimento em SQL, Python, R e bibliotecas como TensorFlow, Keras e PyTorch. Familiaridade com plataformas de nuvem (Azure, Google Cloud ou AWS) será um diferencial.

  • Experiência em trabalhar com grandes quantidades de dados reais com SQL (Teradata, Oracle ou MySQL) e R, ou outro pacote estatístico;

Na ITA Distribuidora, temos um compromisso: levar os melhores alimentos para os mineiros com excelência, qualidade e responsabilidade. Nossa missão vai além da distribuição: queremos transformar vidas, promovendo o crescimento de nossos colaboradores e superando as expectativas de nossos clientes. Estamos em busca de profissionais comprometidos para nos apoiar nessa jornada.

Se você procura um ambiente de crescimento contínuo, aprendizado constante e trabalho em equipe, venha fazer parte da ITA. Aqui, transformamos sonhos em realidade!

Realizar manutenção elétrica preventiva e corretiva de baixa complexidade em componentes de caminhões, máquinas agrícolas e painéis de controle de maquinários e implementos agrícolas, garantindo seu funcionamento com menor custo.

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

ART

What We Do

Push your artistic talent to the limit on a team of world-class environment, character and concept artists who strive to innovate and inspire.

What You'll Do

The Walt Disney Company and Epic Games are collaborating on an all-new games and entertainment universe. In addition to being a world-class games experience, this new persistent universe will offer a multitude of opportunities for consumers to play, watch, and engage with content, characters, and stories from Disney, Pixar, Marvel, Star Wars, Avatar, and more. Players, gamers, and fans of all kinds will be able to create their own stories and experiences, express their fandom in a distinctly Disney way, and share content with each other in ways that they love. Come join us in creating the future of interactive entertainment. Epic Games is seeking a Senior Technical Animator with a passion for expressive character movement. In this talented team of veteran and emerging artists, you’ll collaborate across teams and contribute directly to the next Epic project. Joining this team means you’re motivated to seek solutions to problems and work with other artists to make positive changes to models, movements, and tools. The heart of this role is rigging, pipeline, and tooling.

In this role, you will

  • Rig characters, props, and vehicles
  • Set up assets in Unreal Engine 5; including cloth, physics, and blueprints
  • Work closely with modelers and animators to ensure a smooth development pipeline that delivers high-quality assets
  • Assist with pipeline tools and work with engine and project leads on the continuous improvement of those engine tools

What we're looking for

  • Extensive experience rigging characters in Maya, Houdini, or other DCC
  • A portfolio demonstrating rigging for a range of characters, bipeds, and creatures, both body and faces
  • Attention to aesthetic detail, especially with regard to character deformation and physics movement
  • Familiarity with the Unreal Engine 5 art pipeline
  • Positive individual with strong written communication and teamwork skills
  • Exceptional problem-solver
  • Experience developing character pipelines and tools

EPIC JOB + EPIC BENEFITS = EPIC LIFE

We pay 100% for benefits for both employees (EEs) and dependents (deps). Our current benefits package includes coverage for medical, dental, and life insurance. We also offer supplemental benefits including daily meal vouchers, and commuter benefits for onsite employees.

ABOUT US

Epic Games spans across 25 countries with 46 studios and 4,500+ employees globally. For over 25 years, we've been making award-winning games and engine technology that empowers others to make visually stunning games and 3D content that bring environments to life like never before. Epic's award-winning Unreal Engine technology not only provides game developers the ability to build high-fidelity, interactive experiences for PC, console, mobile, and VR, it is also a tool being embraced by content creators across a variety of industries such as media and entertainment, automotive, and architectural design. As we continue to build our Engine technology and develop remarkable games, we strive to build teams of world-class talent.

Like what you hear? Come be a part of something Epic!

Epic Games deeply values diverse teams and an inclusive work culture, and we are proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. Learn more about our Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Policy here .

Note to Recruitment Agencies: Epic does not accept any unsolicited resumes or approaches from any unauthorized third party (including recruitment or placement agencies) (i.e., a third party with whom we do not have a negotiated and validly executed agreement). We will not pay any fees to any unauthorized third party. Further details on these matters can be found here .

At Bunge, people don't just come here to work, they come here to grow - solving challenges that directly impact the world with a diverse team of thinkers and doers. Bunge offers a strong compensation and benefits package, generous paid time off program, flexible work arrangements, and opportunity to progress. Our hybrid work environment provides a balance of in-office and remote work.


Most importantly, in all we do we live our values:


• Act as One Team by fostering inclusion, collaboration, and respect
• Drive for Excellence by being agile, innovative and efficient
• Do What's Right by acting safely, ethically, and sustainably

Overview

We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Senior Data Scientist with strong expertise in predictive and prescriptive model applied to industrial operations to join our growing team. As Senior Data Scientist, you will be responsible for driving the construction of models to solve business problems, communicate to the technical team, and assure the delivery matches business expectations. You will also be responsible for working with cross-functional teams to identify and prioritize data analytics initiatives.

Main Accountabilities

· Design, create, test and implement complex models and algorithms that drive analytical solutions throughout the organization.

· Collaborate with business analyst and understand business problems to implement scalable and sustainable solutions.

· Design and structure reusable codebase

· Communicates the design, functioning and output of the analytical models/solutions developed

· Ensure timely analysis and testing for regular maintenance of solutions over time

· Communicate data insights to stakeholders.

Knowledge and Technical Competencies

· Proficient in data science, optimization, machine learning, Python, R, SQL, data analysis, analytical skills, teamwork, and communication skills.

· Develop business awareness of possible use cases and help them to understand the necessary concepts of data science and optimization to ensure better communication across functions.

Education/Experience

· Proficient in Python

· Strong foundations in math, analytics and computer science, knowledge of machine learning methods, statistical models, advanced data science programming

· Avoid greenhorn mistakes, avoid logical flaws in the models, revisits high-performing systems, write reusable code, builds resilient data pipelines in the cloud environment, and prepares immaculate data.

· Deep understanding of Database designs. Prior course work is a plus

· Creative & innovative thinking; demonstrating drive to solve problems.

· Act as a great team player and pitch new ideas, take responsibility to improve code quality and impact.

Bunge (NYSE: BG) is a world leader in sourcing, processing and supplying oilseed and grain products and ingredients. Founded in 1818, Bunge’s expansive network feeds and fuels a growing world, creating sustainable products and opportunities for more than 70,000 farmers and the consumers they serve across the globe. The company is headquartered in St. Louis, Missouri and has 25,000 employees worldwide who stand behind more than 350 port terminals, oilseed processing plants, grain facilities, and food and ingredient production and packaging facilities around the world.

Bunge is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Veterans/Disabled


Job Segment: Computer Science, Business Analyst, Sustainable Agriculture, Database, SQL, Technology, Agriculture

description:
About CloudWalk:

We are not just another fintech unicorn. We are a team of dreamers, makers, and tech enthusiasts building the future of payments. With millions of satisfied customers and a focus on innovation, we are expanding our capabilities both literally and metaphorically.

We’re seeking an Administrative Analyst to join our dynamic team. This role offers hands-on experience in a fast-paced legal environment within a cutting-edge company. If you are proactive, eager to learn about technology, and interested in developing administrative and operational skills in the legal field, this is a great opportunity for growth.

Responsibilities:
  • Manage and update internal records and legal documentation in compliance systems.
  • Support the registration, organization, and archiving of legal documents and reports.
  • Assist in responding to official requests, notifications, and legal inquiries under supervision.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to ensure accurate and timely documentation processing.
  • Utilize AI tools and automation platforms to streamline workflows.
  • Participate in training to understand legal operations and fintech regulations.
  • Maintain confidentiality and comply with legal and regulatory standards.
Qualifications:
  • Strong organizational and analytical skills with attention to detail.
  • Interest in technology, automation, and AI-driven workflows.
  • Proficiency with digital tools such as Google Workspace and familiarity with tech platforms.
  • Effective communication skills and ability to collaborate in a fast-paced environment.
  • Curiosity and willingness to learn about fintech, compliance, and legal processes.
  • Fluent in English.
Nice to Have:
  • Experience with low-code/no-code automation tools or willingness to learn.
  • Interest in legal operations, compliance, or fintech topics.

The Future of Legal Operations:

At CloudWalk, we believe AI and automation will transform business operations:

  • Legal teams using AI for document processing and compliance tracking.
  • Automated workflows enhancing efficiency and accuracy.
  • Real-time decision-making and risk assessment through digital processes.
  • Seamless integration of legal and regulatory compliance into business growth.

This is just the beginning. Together, we will build a smarter, faster, and more automated future for legal operations. Are you ready to join us?

Join CloudWalk: Be part of a team creating an AI-driven future for payments and legal operations.

title: Business Analytics Manager
description:
Your wellbeing matters. Join a company that cares.

GET TO KNOW US

Wellhub (formerly Gympass*) is a corporate wellness platform that connects employees to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep, all included in one subscription designed to cost less than each individual partner. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in NYC, we have a growing global team in 11 countries. At Wellhub, you have the opportunity to build a career in a high-growth tech company that places wellbeing at the foundation of its culture, and contribute to making every company a wellness company.

*Big news: Gympass is now Wellhub!
We are thrilled to announce our rebranding as Wellhub, marking a significant milestone in our journey. This transformation reflects our evolution from a “pass for gyms” to a comprehensive employee wellbeing solution. With our refreshed identity, we are poised to embark on an exciting new chapter of growth and expansion. We are elevating our offerings, including a completely new app experience and an expanded network of wellbeing partners. Learn more about it here.

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a Business Analytics Manager to ourPartner Sales Operations team in São Paulo, Brazil .

Wellhub Partnerships team is looking for a Sales Operations Analytics Manager to partner with our Regional Sales Operations Leads across the Globe (Latam, US and Europe) and support commercial leaders and their teams to make more data driven decisions through excellence in business intelligence. This will be a highly collaborative global position working closely with Sales Operations, Analytics and Commercial leaders. The Sales Operations Analytics Manager will report to the Director of Sales Operations and has no direct reports. You will be responsible for scaling our analytical capabilities through dashboards and strategic models, ensuring consistency in our planning, forecasting and insights generation within the partnerships organization..

YOUR IMPACT

  • Develop analytical models to calculate OKR and variable compensation targets

Valorizamos todas as formas de diversidade e encorajamos você a conhecer melhor essa oportunidade abaixo. Candidate-se para a vaga, e nos mostre a sua história e potencial. Se você sentir aquele frio na barriga é um ótimo sinal, pois esse pode ser o primeiro passo da nossa história!

O Nosso Jeito de Ser tem a # Saúde_e_Segurança como princípio. Para atrair e reter os melhores talentos, oferecemos um pacote de benefícios completo que contribuem para a qualidade de vida dos nossos funcionários e funcionárias:

  • Plano médico e odontológico

Nossos pacotes de benefícios são configurados conforme acordo coletivo da unidade e regras de elegibilidade.

Sobre nossa empresa

Somos uma empresa de materiais de construção e soluções sustentáveis com mais de 13 mil empregados. Nossa trajetória começa em 1936, com a inauguração da nossa fábrica de Santa Helena, na cidade de Votorantim, no interior de São Paulo. Durante quase um século de existência, expandimos nossos negócios e mercados, cruzamos fronteiras e hoje somos uma das maiores empresas do setor no mundo. Atualmente, estamos presentes no Brasil e em mais dez países: Argentina, Bolívia, Canadá, Espanha, Estados Unidos, Luxemburgo, Marrocos, Tunísia, Turquia e Uruguai. Somos uma empresa feita de gente que faz, que acredita, que constrói. Sempre juntos e com excelência para chegarmos cada vez mais longe, entregando resultados sustentáveis e ajudando a construir um mundo melhor para todos. E você pode fazer parte disso! Conheça nossas unidades de negócio:

Unidades de negócio

Engemix

A Engemix é a unidade de negócios de concreto da Votorantim Cimentos. Fundada em 1968, a Engemix firmou-se como referência em qualidade de concreto. Com mais de 40 centrais de concreto estrategicamente posicionadas em todo o território brasileiro, ao longo de sua trajetória a marca Engemix participou das principais obras do Brasil, como o Aeroporto de Guarulhos e a Ponte Estaiada, ambas no Estado de São Paulo; a Arena do Grêmio, localizada em Porto Alegre (RS); o Parque Eólico, em Aracati (CE); o Parque Olímpico, localizado no Rio de Janeiro (RJ); e a Arena Pernambuco, no Recife (PE). Mais informações no site:

Viter

A Viter é unidade de insumos agrícolas da Votorantim Cimentos. A marca é líder em comercialização de calcário agrícola no Brasil e a única com presença nacional. Com o propósito de despertar e perpetuar o potencial máximo do solo, seus produtos têm origem garantida e a marca disponibiliza assistência técnica para análise e entendimento do solo. Atua com cinco linhas de produtos: Calcário ITAÚ Fyller e convencional; Calfértil, que são óxidos de cálcio e magnésio; Optmix, mistura homogênea e industrializada de calcário e gesso; Sungard, protetor solar para folhas e frutos; e Granumax V, fertilizante granulado. Mais informações no site:

Verdera

A Verdera é a unidade de gestão e destinação sustentável de resíduos da Votorantim Cimentos. Desde 1991, a empresa atua com coprocessamento e foi pioneira em trazer essa tecnologia para o Brasil. A Verdera atua na cadeia de soluções ambientais dando um novo valor para os resíduos. É um parceiro com alta capacidade de realização, que entende as particularidades de cada negócio e que está comprometido a fazer do jeito certo e a pensar de forma diferente para descobrir novas possibilidades que transformem a realidade de todos. title: Embedded System Developer - Developer Experience
description:
Embedded System Developer - Developer Experience

Toradex is a global company strongly focused on engineering & technology. We’re powered by a diverse & uniquely gifted workforce. We pursue the best people to propel our innovative vision of embedded computing and IoT. If you’re interested in being a driving force at an agile technology company, engineering clever computing solutions & helping other companies bring their products to life, we should talk.

Description

Toradex’s Brazil office hosts parts of the Global Sales, Marketing, and R&D teams, composed of several engineers working on diverse tasks with global reach. Toradex teams are mission-oriented, high-performing collaborative, and empowered to innovate & improve products & services (including open-source projects) for the benefit of our customers and the industry.

Mission

As an Embedded System Developer in the Developer Experience team, you will work to accelerate the time-to-market of our customers through the provision of technical support, the production of technical documentation, and the creation of demonstrations and proofs-of-concept. You will drive our efforts to have the best self-serving support experience in the industry. You will closely collaborate with R&D, Product Management, and Marketing.

Your responsibilities will include the items below:

  • Create the leading Self Service Support Experience in the Industry through one-to-many support resources (documentation, community forum), artificial intelligence and support automation
  • Make complex technical concepts easy to understand for Toradex target customers
  • Being a key stakeholder in the overall user experience of Toradex products
  • Interact with customers using our support channels (email, community, documentation)
  • Help scale our support by updating documentation based on direct interactions with customers.

Requirements

  • Hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical/Electronic Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, or Computer Science.
  • Availability to work from the Toradex Office in Campinas/SP at least 4 days a week
  • Detail-oriented and capable of managing multiple tasks simultaneously.
  • Ability and passion to learn new technologies, and develop skills in embedded software and hardware.
  • Ability to work both independently and collaboratively within a team-oriented environment.
  • Good Novel Problem-Solving Skills
  • Experience and knowledge as a user or system administrator
  • Experience with Embedded Linux or with a Linux Development
  • Developed Applications for Embedded Linux Devices
  • Knowledge of common interfaces and how to use them on the software side, such as:
    • GPIO, I2C, SPI, UART, MIPI-CSI, LVDS and more.
  • Experience with Git: Managed (possibly jointly) a Git Repository with multiple contributors
  • Able to read and comprehend hardware schematics
  • Knowledge of programming patterns and anti-patterns
  • Programming languages
    • C/C++
    • Python
  • Knowledge of at least one Shell Scripting Language, such as Bash or Perl
  • Strong proficiency in English with excellent written and verbal communication skills

Preferred:

  • Experience providing technical support to customers
  • Previous exposure to the developer community
  • Previous experience or courses working with Yocto
  • Familiarity with Docker containers
  • Experience with CI/CD
  • Knowledge of Agile development concepts
  • Knowledge of AI/ML, preferably on embedded devices
  • Designed a working PCB from scratch either professionally or as a hobby
  • Passion and skill to communicate about products and technical concepts in webinars, blogs, and talks

What we Offer:

  • An agile and inter-cultural work environment
  • Working with latest IoT computer technology in an international environment
  • Participation in defining processes and your working environment
  • Contemporary employment conditions, modern office space and a flexible working environment
  • Opportunities for your personal development

Desired Candidate Profile:

Toradex is providing and dynamic, fun and exciting work environment. We are looking for somebody who has similar values, is passionate about his work, and is motivated to learn new things. We try to constantly improve and expect the same from you.

Toradex is a leader in embedded computing, serving innovative products to industrial, medical, automotive & IoT companies creating feature-rich & intelligent systems for demanding applications, e.g. supercars, self-driving tractors, patient monitoring systems – to name a few.

We provide effective & robust embedded computing solutions and strive for the best development experience in the industry with a focus on intelligent hardware design, innovative software solutions & free comprehensive support. Our relationship with our customers ensures that we all succeed and it allows us to participate in the realization of incredible new products. Our products are directly sold to more than 3'000 industrial customers in over 70 different countries worldwide.

Contabilidade: A Arte de Contar Histórias com Números!

Para além dos balanços e demonstrações financeiras — somos contadores de histórias através de números. Aqui você irá analisar dados, elaborar relatórios e garantir que as finanças da empresa estejam sempre em dia. Se você é detalhista e adora resolver quebra-cabeças, este é o seu lugar!


Compras: A Estratégia de Encontrar Oportunidades no Mercado!

Nossa equipe de Compras vai além de negociar e adquirir produtos — somos especialistas em identificar as melhores oportunidades de mercado e garantir que a empresa tenha tudo o que precisa para operar com excelência. Aqui você será responsável por negociar com fornecedores, analisar custos e garantir que os processos de aquisição sejam ágeis e eficientes. Se você é uma pessoa estratégica, com visão analítica e gosta de encontrar soluções vantajosas, este é o seu lugar!


Contas a Pagar: A Responsabilidade de Garantir a Saúde Financeira!

Além de processar pagamentos — somos responsáveis por manter o fluxo financeiro da empresa sempre em dia, garantindo que todos os compromissos sejam cumpridos com precisão e no prazo. Aqui você será responsável por gerenciar faturas, controlar vencimentos e assegurar que as transações sejam realizadas de forma eficiente. Se você é organizado, detalhista e possui forte senso de responsabilidade, este é o seu lugar!


Controladoria: O Coração da Governança Financeira!

Somos os guardiões da precisão e da integridade financeira da empresa. Aqui você vai mergulhar em processos de controle, auditoria e planejamento orçamentário, garantindo que cada decisão financeira seja tomada com confiança e responsabilidade. Se você busca um ambiente de aprendizado sólido e desafiador, essa área é para você!


Controles Internos: Garantindo a Eficiência e Segurança dos Processos!

Nossa equipe vai além de monitorar processos — somos responsáveis por assegurar que as operações da empresa aconteçam de forma eficiente, transparente e segura, minimizando riscos e garantindo a conformidade. Aqui você irá avaliar e melhorar os controles existentes, realizando auditorias e propondo soluções para otimizar os processos. Se você é detalhista, analítico e gosta de garantir a integridade dos processos, este é o seu lugar!


Crédito e Cobrança: Contribuindo para o Sucesso Financeiro da Empresa!

Nosso objetivo é garantir a saúde financeira da empresa, mantendo um fluxo de caixa estável e eficiente. Aqui você terá a oportunidade de executar técnicas de negociação, gestão de crédito e relacionamento com clientes, sendo parte fundamental do nosso sucesso. Tem perfil comunicativo e gosta de desafios? Junte-se ao nosso time!


Fiscal/Tributário: Desvendando o Mundo dos Impostos!

Esse time é especialista em navegar pelo complexo universo da legislação fiscal. Aqui você irá atuar na otimização de carga tributária da empresa, analisar normas fiscais e colaborar em projetos de compliance. Se você tem afinidade com números e adora um bom desafio legal, essa área é a sua cara!


P&A (Planejamento Financeiro e Análise): Onde a Estratégia Financeira Ganha Vida!

No time de FP&A, você será parte essencial da construção de cenários e projeções que direcionam as decisões estratégicas da empresa. Aqui você mergulhará no universo das análises financeiras, ajudando a transformar dados em insights valiosos para o futuro do nosso negócio. Curioso e analítico? Venha com a gente!


Funding: Impulsionando o Crescimento da Empresa!

Nós captamos recursos e muito mais — somos responsáveis por garantir que a empresa tenha o financiamento necessário para impulsionar seu crescimento e atingir seus objetivos estratégicos. Aqui você será responsável por identificar fontes de financiamento, negociar com investidores e acompanhar as condições de captação. Se você é estratégico, proativo e tem afinidade com o mercado financeiro, este é o seu lugar!


RGM (Revenue Growth Management): Estratégia para Maximizar o Crescimento da Receita!

Além de analisar dados financeiros — somos responsáveis por desenvolver estratégias que impulsionem o crescimento sustentável da receita, otimizando preços, promoções e a gestão de canais. Aqui você irá identificar oportunidades de crescimento, analisar tendências de mercado e garantir que as decisões comerciais estejam alinhadas com os objetivos financeiros da empresa. Se você é analítico, estratégico e tem visão para identificar oportunidades de maximizar a receita, este é o seu lugar!


M&A (Fusões e Aquisições): Ajudando a Construir o Futuro da Empresa!

Esse time está sempre em busca de novas oportunidades de crescimento. Aqui você vai avaliar investimentos, realizar due diligence, e participar de negociações que definem o rumo da empresa. É apaixonado por estratégia e mercados financeiros? Venha nos ajudar a construir o futuro!


Tesouraria: Gestão Eficiente do Fluxo de Caixa!

Somos feras em gerenciar os recursos financeiros — somos responsáveis por garantir que a empresa tenha sempre o capital necessário para suas operações, além de planejar e controlar os fluxos de caixa, investimentos e financiamentos. Aqui você irá controlar a liquidez da empresa, monitorar contas bancárias e garantir que as operações financeiras aconteçam de maneira eficiente e segura. Se você é detalhista, tem visão estratégica e um forte controle financeiro, este é o seu lugar!

Para esses desafios você precisa:

  • Residir em uma de nossas cidades base (Curitiba, São Paulo, Fortaleza) ou ter disponibilidade para mudança;
  • Possuir experiência na área financeira.

Buscamos talentos que tenham:

  • Bons conhecimentos em ferramentas de dados como Excel e BI;
  • Capacidade de agir de forma autônoma e buscar soluções criativas para problemas;
  • Boa comunicação e capacidade de construir pontes relacionais com diferentes áreas;
  • Habilidade para interpretar dados, elaborar relatórios e contribuir para a tomada de decisões;
  • Capacidade de lidar com mudanças e desafios em um ambiente corporativo, adaptando-se rapidamente aos novos cenários;

Diferenciais:

Com o compromisso de estarmos na vanguarda da mineração, em 2020 tivemos a antiga barragem de rejeito da Mina do Gama descaracterizada pela ANM. Investimos no processo de filtragem de 100% do rejeito gerado com posterior empilhamento a seco. Além disso, promovemos o reaproveitamento de aproximadamente 85% da água utilizada no processo de produção, intensificamos a gestão ambiental, a saúde e a segurança das operações, e também investimos em várias ações sociais. Posteriormente, em 2022, iniciamos uma nova operação na cidade de Mariana.

Nossa atuação gerou, até este momento, mais de 1.000 empregos diretos, somados a outros 1.500 indiretos como transportadores do nosso produto e prestadores de serviços focados na valorização pessoal e profissional, na saúde e segurança. Investimos constantemente na capacitação do nosso time de colaboradores, que atuam nas operações de Nova Lima e Mariana.

Na Cedro Mineração, estamos dedicados a moldar um setor de mineração que contribua para um futuro sustentável e próspero enquanto preservamos o ambiente e fortalecemos a vida das pessoas ao nosso redor. Conheça nossa missão, nossa visão e valores!

Precisamos de pessoas que acreditem no futuro da mineração e que estejam prontas para fazer a diferença dentro da Cedro.

Nosso objetivo é conduzir um processo seletivo simplificado e escolher as pessoas certas, aquelas que vistam a camisa da Cedro, e incentivam aqueles que vivem nos municípios onde atuamos para se juntar a nós.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  1. Realizar a coleta de resíduo diária no site da mina e a segregação de resíduos de acordo com a coleta seletiva;
  2. Organizar as baias de resíduos e auxiliar na realização das destinações de resíduos;
  3. Realizar a limpeza e organização de áreas;
  4. Realizar a limpeza de caixas d’água, higienização de bebedouros;
  5. Realizar o controle e limpeza de cursos d’água e sistemas de drenagem;
  6. Realizar controle de sistemas de tratamento de efluentes;
  7. Realizar inspeção de kits de mitigação e sistemas de contenção de vazamento;
  8. Instalar e realizar manutenção de placas de sinalização e pontaletes;
  9. Realizar recarga de álcool em gel e troca de água de lava olhos;

title: Immigration Consultant
description:
Join to apply for the Immigration Consultant role at CIBT

Join to apply for the Immigration Consultant role at CIBT

Our Immigration Consultants are responsible for helping corporations and private clients successfully complete the relevant immigration process so that they are able to live and work around the world. They develop a strong service relationship with clients upon contact to ensure that each case is handled expediently, accurately, and consistent with global standards. A key part of the role is to liaise directly with clients, understanding their situation and ensuring the appropriate solutions. Our Consultants use their commercial and professional expertise to provide prompt, high quality, tailored advice and guidance based on individual client needs. We help ensure clients obtain the relevant visas, work permits, visa extensions, settlement and passport and nationality papers in a smooth and stress-free manner.

Consultants enjoy the opportunity to regularly communicate with clients and relevant authorities by email or telephone, while also ensuring adherence to strict deadlines. The Immigration team and our customers come from different cultural and nationality backgrounds and this adds to the variety and diversity of our work. In return, CIBT will provide you with an interesting and varied role, career opportunities and the ability to contribute directly to the success of a rapidly growing business.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Carrying out volume casework for assigned countries, including case initiation, case assessment, provision of advice on applicable rules and procedures, case preparation and submission, monitoring progress and follow up on completion.
  • Acts as dedicated point of contact to clients, providing highly personalized services that meet client needs. Takes ownership of client relationship and provides clients with informed advice that reflects best practices and compliance. Conducts regular review of accounts, assists with training for corporate clients
  • Works closely and seamlessly with Network Partner/Attorney, where applicable, to support client needs – within casework to coordinate strategy, hold assessment and introductory calls, review materials and case product, align on processing and case updates
  • Monitoring application deadlines and completing assigned work within the appropriate timeframes.
  • Using sound judgement in assessing client risk and escalating potential issues to senior management in a timely manner.
  • Taking care to consider alternatives and delivering appropriate decisions with minimal senior management involvement.
  • Monitoring visa expiry dates and alerting the client appropriately.
  • Ensuring that the appropriate client records are established and maintained and that key correspondence and documentation is saved into the client e-file.
  • Ensuring that all work undertaken is in scope, is billed promptly on completion, and that additional fees are agreed in advance for additional services. Ensuring that use of the corporate credit card is recorded in an accurate and timely fashion and within the associated case, where applicable. Listens intently to the client needs to ensure that these needs are met and anticipating customer needs, offering pro-active advice. Remaining updated on industry events/circumstances that may be relevant to the client.
  • Communicating regularly with clients to build a strong relationship while focusing on business needs and ensuring that client service review meetings are held regularly, with formal agendas and presentations
  • Attends client meetings, telephone & video conferences/ webinars as required.
  • Identifying, pursuing and generating new business leads, ensuring that work is profitable.
  • Using exceptional organizational skills to meet or exceed customer expectations (including where SLAs are in place). Responding to email and telephone enquiries in a timely manner and ensuring that advice is comprehensive and accurate, managing expectations where needed and escalating issues promptly and appropriately.
  • Utilizing resources and researching complex cases/scenarios.
  • Recommending improvements in work procedures, policies or systems in area of assigned responsibility.
  • Ensuring the client receives appropriate news updates and alerts.
  • Personal involvement with seminars, webinars, internal and external networking events etc.
  • Guiding and training junior team members in identifying and assessing client risk.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in related field, plus 3 years of experience or Associate’s degree plus 5 years of experience in related field.
  • Speak and write in English proficiently, professionally, and objectively.
  • Ability to manage time effectively by prioritizing, identifying and addressing critical tasks, while remaining flexible to changing priorities.
  • Ability to work with professionalism, honesty and integrity maintaining confidentiality at all times and to model the company values.

About CIBT:

With over 30 years of experience, CIBT is the leading global provider of travel visa, immigration, and document services for corporations and individuals. We simplify the journey to bridge people, cultures, and business, and open the world together with our 1,700+ immigration & tax experts and visa professionals located in 60+ offices in 27 countries.

As the primary service provider to 75% of Fortune 500 companies, CIBT offers a comprehensive suite of services under three primary brands: CIBTvisas , our business and travel visa services; Newland Chase , our global immigration and tax strategy and advisory services; and Blair , our document legalization services.

We are committed to building a great global company with self-starters who help carry us forward. We hire driven, dedicated people and give them the opportunity to learn and contribute to our growing organization while creating their own career path.

title: [Ambev Global Tech] Cloud Architect
description:
Job Description

Estamos à procura de um Cloud Architect talentoso para integrar nossa equipe inovadora e dinâmica. Neste cargo, você será responsável por projetar e implementar soluções em nuvem escaláveis, seguras e confiáveis, que atendam às diversas necessidades de nossos clientes. Como Cloud Architect, você colaborará de perto com equipes multifuncionais, incluindo desenvolvedores de software, engenheiros de sistemas e gerentes de produto, para definir estratégias, políticas e melhores práticas relacionadas à nuvem.

Sua compreensão aprofundada de infraestrutura e serviços em nuvem permitirá que você gerencie as complexidades envolvidas na criação e manutenção de ambientes na nuvem. Além disso, você será encarregado de avaliar os sistemas atuais e recomendar melhorias para otimizar o desempenho e a relação custo-benefício.

Além do trabalho técnico, você desempenhará um papel fundamental ao fornecer liderança e orientação sobre estratégias de adoção de nuvem em toda a organização, garantindo que as partes interessadas estejam engajadas e bem informadas. O candidato ideal deve possuir fortes habilidades de comunicação e resolução de problemas, juntamente com uma paixão por aproveitar tecnologias de nuvem para gerar resultados empresariais.

Esta é uma oportunidade empolgante para um profissional altamente motivado que busca causar um impacto significativo em um ambiente colaborativo, focado na melhoria contínua e na inovação em serviços de nuvem.

Responsibilities and assignments

  • Projetar e implementar soluções de cloud architecture que estejam alinhadas com os objetivos de negócios;
  • Colaborar com as equipes de desenvolvimento para criar sistemas escaláveis, altamente disponíveis e tolerantes a falhas na nuvem;
  • Avaliar e recomendar serviços e tecnologias de nuvem com base nas necessidades do cliente, desempenho e considerações orçamentárias;
  • Garantir a segurança e a conformidade das soluções em nuvem, implementando as melhores práticas e padrões da indústria;
  • Solucionar problemas relacionados à nuvem e fornecer suporte para garantir desempenho otimizado;
  • Desenvolver e manter soluções de gerenciamento e monitoramento de nuvem para proporcionar visibilidade e controle dos recursos em nuvem;
  • Criar documentação detalhada que abranja o design da arquitetura, políticas, procedimentos e diretrizes de suporte.

Requirements And Qualifications

  • Experiência comprovada como Cloud Architect ou em um papel similar, projetando e gerenciando soluções em nuvem;
  • Sólido conhecimento de plataformas de nuvem como Azure e AWS;
  • Experiência com tecnologias de conteinerização, como Docker e Kubernetes;
  • Familiaridade com conceitos de segurança em nuvem e melhores práticas;
  • Capacidade de analisar cargas de trabalho do sistema e realizar o planejamento de capacidade para recursos em nuvem;
  • Habilidades de comunicação eficazes para transmitir conceitos técnicos complexos a partes interessadas não técnicas;
  • Certificações em nuvem (por exemplo, AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Google Cloud Certified) são preferenciais;
  • Inglês Avançado/Fluente.

title: Associate Director of Creative, Acquisition
description:
We're building the future of advertising and are looking for the minds to help us do it.

Darkroom is a vertically integrated digital agency pioneering the next generation of consumer-facing brands. A category leader in results-driven growth marketing, Darkroom’s success is attributed to our unique partnership model, purposefully built to launch brands to market and accelerate growth across direct-to-consumer. Our model is predicated on three major partnership structures - Growth & Scaling, Digital Platforms, and Brand & Product Launches – threaded by one cohesive, interdisciplinary team.

Taking the startup mindset to the agency space, the collective expertise of our team of entrepreneurs and senior digital marketers are deeply aware of the newest trends in e-commerce, development, and digital marketing. Our learned experience has allowed us to take clients (and internal ventures) from $0 to millions in revenue in just a few months. We work with game-changing brands: Crate & Barrel, Popchips, FEED, Olipop, & CALPAK, to name a few.

We’re looking for a visionary creative leader with deep experience in developing ad concepts for acquisition marketing on Meta. You’re able to dive deep into the pixels and give tactical feedback on design and video, but understand how to thread the needle between performance frameworks, creative testing, and world-building assets. You’re likely a Designer or Creative Strategist by trade but hyper-focused on paid media.

You’ll work on our Dark Arts service, that has been newly relaunched as the AI-powered creative direction service for paid media clients. This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of creativity, AI, and performance - combining bold visual storytelling with data-informed design decisions. You'll report to the Director of Creative and lead the management of Designers and Editors to execute paid media assets across a variety of formats, including static ads, short-form videos, motion graphics, and UGC content.

Your work will directly impact client performance by delivering a high-volume of ad concepts, elevated creative direction, and data-backed testing frameworks. You’ll collaborate closely with performance marketers, designers, and video editors in a fast-paced, remote environment.

This is a fully remote role operating in the EST Time Zone and all business is conducted 100% in English. Open to candidates in the following locations: Brazil, Mexico, Portugal, and Spain.

Management Responsibilities

  • Manage a team of 2-4 designers focused on paid ad creative, with room to grow the team over time.

  • Provide creative direction, actionable feedback, and career support through regular 1:1s and project reviews.

  • Oversee creative quality, ensuring assets align with brand identity, platform best practices, and campaign objectives.

  • Partner with performance marketers and strategists to develop and iterate on high-performing ad campaigns.

  • Help refine internal processes, establish creative standards, and lead collaborative sessions to drive creative innovation.

Senior Individual Contributor Responsibilities

  • Lead concept development and execution for paid media campaigns across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, and display platforms.

  • Translate client’s marketing strategy and performance data into clear, compelling ad concepts.

  • Design and direct a range of assets including static ads, animations, mobile-first videos, and storyboards for short-form content.

  • Present creative work to stakeholders and clients with clarity, confidence, and strategic rationale.

  • Monitor performance data in collaboration with the marketing team to inform creative iterations and improve results over time.

You should apply if this sounds like you:

  • 3+ years of senior-level design experience, with at least 1 year of people management experience preferred. Must have experience designing ad creatives for paid media campaigns across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, or similar platforms.

  • A digital portfolio showcasing performance-focused ad creative - including static ads, motion graphics, and short-form video - with a strong understanding of visual hierarchy, composition, and platform-specific best practices.

  • Knowledge of how to incorporate AI software into workflows to increase efficiencies and output, including ChatGPT, Midjourney, Perplexity, Icon, and more.

  • Self-motivated, proactive, and detail-oriented with a strong sense of ownership and accountability to performance results.

  • Skilled at working with performance marketers and creative strategists to write briefs, incorporate feedback, and iterate based on ad performance data.

  • Comfortable communicating in English with internal teams and clients, including presenting creative work and responding to feedback clearly and professionally.

  • Confident giving constructive feedback to other designers and supporting their growth through clear direction and mentorship.

  • Able to take ambiguous campaign goals and turn them into creative concepts that are visually engaging and conversion-focused.

  • Proficient in Figma for ad design workflows; knowledge of Auto Layout, Components, and asset handoff is essential.

  • Experience using Adobe Creative Suite (especially Photoshop and Illustrator) for asset creation and layout design.

  • Bonus: Experience designing high-performing ads for e-commerce brands, familiarity with motion design tools (After Effects, Premiere), or working with UGC creators and editors.

What its like to work at Darkroom:

We're building the future of advertising and are looking for the minds to help us do it. We only seek out the best—from our clients to our people. Our team is our most sacred asset, and we offer highly competitive salaries and the following perks:

  • Darkweek, Unlimited Vacation Policy, and Holidays: Rebooting is one of the most important parts of growth. At Darkroom, you have access to a flexible vacation policy, our annual “Darkweek” summer break, and 10 holidays throughout the year to keep you recharged and sharp.

  • Darkroom offers a Phantom Equity Incentive Plan—a long-term, seniority-based cash bonus that vests over five years and pays out if the company is sold, rewarding those who help us grow.

  • Finances, growth, and retirement: After one year with Darkroom, we deliver a robust 401k program with company match, equity incentives, and a profit-sharing opportunity so we can help you save as the company grows.

  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross-functional collaboration.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

Gerente Comercial PJ - Feira de Santana/BA

Ser responsável pela gestão comercial da carteira de clientes da sua atuação, realizando visitas externas, visando a manutenção e crescimento de ativos e serviços, com objetivo de apoiar o desenvolvimento do pequeno e médio varejista brasileiro, provendo recursos financeiros necessários para o crescimento e desenvolvimento de seus negócios.
Responsabilidades e atribuições
É importante destacar que no dia a dia, você realizará as seguintes atividades:

  • Realizar gerenciamento da carteira de clientes, desenvolvendo a verticalização de produtos e serviços junto aos clientes ativos e reativação dos clientes inativos;
  • Realizar venda de produtos e serviços bancários e visitas de campo;
  • Prospectar clientes com o objetivo de alavancar os negócios da Instituição;

title: GESTOR DE NEGOCIOS I
description:
Você conhece a LDC? A LDC é uma das principais comercializadoras e processadoras global de produtos agrícolas, com um portfólio diversificado, que abrange toda a cadeia de valor, da originação à distribuição. Com atividades no centro da produção agrícola e de alimentos e guiados pelos nossos fortes valores, por um legado rico e uma visão clara, estamos comprometidos em trabalhar por um futuro seguro e sustentável. Ajudamos a alimentar e vestir cerca de 500 milhões de pessoas todos os anos, originando, processando e transportando aproximadamente 81 milhões de toneladas de produtos. Estruturada como uma organização matricial de 6 regiões geográficas e 10 plataformas, a LDC está ativa em mais de 100 países e emprega cerca de 18.000 pessoas em todo o mundo. Somos guiados por valores que norteiam todos os públicos em nosso trabalho. A ética e integridade fazem parte de todas as relações de negócio, assim como a humildade, comprometimento e diversidade.

Descrição da vaga

  1. Relacionamento comercial com a carteira de produtores de menor tamanho (hectares) na região;
  2. Originação (compra) de Soja e Milho para cumprir o programa de exportação e esmagamento (portos e fabricas);
  3. Executar atividades relacionadas aos controles diários da filial;
  4. Acompanhar o Mercado Agrícola via conexão com a Mesa Trading da Regional e Corretores;
  5. Financiamento ao produtor (Custeio de Safra): análise e defesa do crédito (Web Data Base), acompanhamento para constituição das garantias (penhor/hipoteca);

Qualificações

  1. Superior completo em Agronomia ou áreas afins;
  2. Vivência na comercialização de grãos e operações de Barter;
  3. Experiência com softwares de gestão comercial - CRM;

Informações adicionais

Diversidade, Inclusão e Equidade

A diversidade é parte do nosso DNA. A LDC busca sempre criar um ambiente de trabalho diversificado e inclusivo, onde todas as pessoas possam prosperar. Respeitamos e valorizamos talentos de todos os gêneros, idades, raças, etnias, sexualidades, religiões e deficiências. Diversidade é um de nossos valores! Essa oportunidade destina-se também às pessoas com deficiências (PcD).

Sustentabilidade

O valor sustentável está no centro de nosso propósito como empresa. Somos apaixonados pela criação de valor justo e sustentável, tanto para nossos negócios quanto para outros stakeholders da cadeia de valor: nosso pessoal, nossos parceiros comerciais, as comunidades e o meio ambiente ao nosso redor.

Hardware at TRACTIAN

The Hardware team is responsible for designing and improving our IoT devices, dealing with every step of the development process, ranging from PCB design, firmware programming, case design, validations and certifications, always aiming to build trustworthy products that can be produced at a mass scale.

As a Hardware Test Engineer for Electronics, you will be deeply involved in the electrical testing of hardware components and systems. Responsibilities

  • Stay current with advancements in electronic testing equipment and techniques.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, or a closely related technical discipline.
  • 3+ years of experience with hands-on electronic hardware testing and debugging.
  • Strong proficiency with electronic test equipment and diagnostic tools.
  • Knowledge of printed circuit board (PCB) design and testing, including familiarity with EDA tools like KiCad or Altium Designer.
  • Solid understanding of digital and analog circuitry, as well as experience with power electronics.
  • Ability to read and interpret electronic schematics and datasheets.
Bonus Points
  • Experience with RF testing and wireless communications standards.
  • Involvement in open-source hardware projects or community electronics groups.
  • Fluent in English.

Esta organização está iniciando sua jornada na aplicação de soluções com IA e busca um(a) profissional com perfil técnico e propositivo(a) para dar suporte à concepção e desenvolvimento das primeiras soluções inteligentes baseadas em seus dados internos.

Somos um ecossistema que transforma carreiras, acelera negócios e impulsiona a inovação por meio da formação e alocação de talentos. Nosso propósito é conectar pessoas e empresas, oferecendo soluções que promovem a transformação digital e cultivam uma cultura de aprendizado contínuo.

Responsabilidades

  • Projetar e desenvolver soluções de IA utilizando modelos de linguagem (LLMs) e técnicas como RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation).
  • Implementar pipelines de ingestão, pré-processamento e vetorização de dados proprietários.
  • Integrar diferentes fontes de dados estruturados e não estruturados.
  • Trabalhar com ferramentas e frameworks voltados à construção de aplicações inteligentes.
  • Garantir a qualidade, desempenho e escalabilidade das soluções desenvolvidas.
  • Documentar o processo técnico, facilitando futuras evoluções.

Requisitos e qualificações

Obrigatórios

  • Experiência prática com Python no contexto de Inteligência Artificial e NLP.
  • Conhecimento em LLMs (ex: OpenAI, Hugging Face, LLaMA, etc.).
  • Vivência com RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation).
  • Conhecimento de bibliotecas como LangChain, Haystack, FAISS, Pinecone, ChromaDB ou similares.
  • Familiaridade com vetorização de dados e uso de bancos vetoriais.
  • Noções de integração com APIs, bancos de dados e pipelines de dados.

Desejáveis

  • Experiência anterior no desenvolvimento de soluções baseadas em IA generativa.
  • Conhecimento em deploy de aplicações e práticas de MLOps.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas como Docker e serviços em nuvem.
  • Capacidade de traduzir demandas de negócio em soluções técnicas viáveis.

  • Incentivo à educação, com parcerias com instituições de ensino superior e de idiomas.
  • Plataforma de formação Growdev, com conteúdos práticos e alinhados ao mercado de tecnologia.
